# config.migration { #keecas.config.migration }

`migration`

Configuration migration engine for keecas.

Handles automatic migration of configuration files between schema versions,
preserving user values while transforming structure and deprecating/removing keys.

## Classes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [ConfigMigration](#keecas.config.migration.ConfigMigration) | Configuration migration engine. |

### ConfigMigration { #keecas.config.migration.ConfigMigration }

```python
ConfigMigration()
```

Configuration migration engine.

##### needs_migration { #keecas.config.migration.ConfigMigration.needs_migration }

```python
needs_migration(config_version, current_version)
```

Check if config needs migration.

| Name            | Type         | Description                | Default    |
|-----------------|--------------|----------------------------|------------|
| config_version  | [str](`str`) | Version of the config file | _required_ |
| current_version | [str](`str`) | Current schema version     | _required_ |

| Name   | Type           | Description                                  |

##### migrate { #keecas.config.migration.ConfigMigration.migrate }

```python
migrate(config_data, from_version, to_version)
```

Migrate config through all intermediate versions.

Preserves all user-customized values while transforming structure
and handling deprecated/removed keys according to migration functions.

###### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type           | Description                         | Default    |
|--------------|----------------|-------------------------------------|------------|
| config_data  | [dict](`dict`) | Configuration dictionary to migrate | _required_ |
| from_version | [str](`str`)   | Starting schema version             | _required_ |
| to_version   | [str](`str`)   | Target schema version               | _required_ |

###### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                       |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`) | Migrated configuration dictionary |
